title: Four Days Left
about: The quiet collapse of a relationship during the final four days of the fair.
description: This track reflects on a relationship that ended without a dramatic fight or a clear moment that explained what had changed. With only four days left, someone who had been close suddenly felt impossibly distant, leaving me to replay conversations and search for an answer that never really came. The fair continued around us until one final conversation made the ending real. It's about the particular pain of losing someone while they're still standing only a few feet away.

No words that changed the story,

It still felt much the same.
That's all we had to go.
Somewhere between the morning and the night,
No angry words, no slamming doors,
Hoping you would catch my eye.
You'd turn and talk to someone else,
It's funny how a crowded fair
Maybe it started on that hillside.
Maybe there isn't always a reason
You can point to years later.
And you don't realize you're floating apart
Until you can't reach them anymore.
You came to talk one last time.
Then summer came to an end.
The fair packed up, the lights went out,
And so did what we'd been.
Love doesn't always end with tears,
